'''Mourn''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Boz Pity system/Legends|Boz Pity system]]. It shared a synchronous [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] with [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]]. [[Sultan/Legends|Sultan]] [[Nastuonodon]] had created a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army of [[Electric Caliph]]s, which were used after his [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] to wipe out the [[Gargantelle]]s of Boz Pity.

The electric caliphs immolated themselves by igniting Mourn's slow-burning crust. Mourn remained an orb covered with smoke, with its surface glowing with fires.
